text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — we need to align a coordinated bump for API, runtime, console, and SDK next week. Thinking decoupled PRs but a single cut window to avoid incompat. Can everyone confirm blockers?

Priya: +1. Main blocker is changelog entries for api and runtime — I still have 2 pending PRs. Will try to finish by EOD Wed.

Jun: For runtime: need a successful perf benchmark on the new quantized kernel before we tag. If that lands, I can cut the runtime PR Thurs morning.

Sam: SDKs: I have the version+changelog PR ready but holding until API proto lock. Also need to update the example snippets in the console docs. ETA Thu.

Alex: Sounds good. Proposed plan:
- Wed EOD: final changelogs in master / PRs open
- Thu AM: runtime perf + merge runtime bump
- Thu noon: API bump + merge
- Thu 14:00 UTC: SDK + console PRs merged
- Thu 16:00 UTC: cut tags and publish packages

Alex: If anyone needs a different order (e.g., API first), say now. Also flag any migration steps.

Priya: Order is ok. Two small migration notes for API -> SDK: clients may need to re-run codegen if the proto has the schema tweak I landed. I'll add a note in the changelog snippet.

Jun: Perf passed on staging with the new kernel (3% latency regression at 2048, but throughput is stable) — I uploaded the bench logs: https://internal/bench/2245. Recommend we proceed but keep canary traffic low for first hour.

Sam: Can we do a canary rollout policy? Something like:
```
rollout:
  canary: 10% for 1h
  full: after 1h if errors < 0.1%
```
I'll add that to the console rollout config.

Alex: Yes, let's use that. Also reminder: cutoff for changelog publication to customers is Thu 15:00 UTC — if your changelog misses that, it'll go in the next patch.

ReleaseBot: CI status update: api/bump-pr -> success, runtime/bump-pr -> success, sdk/bump-pr -> pending (tests queued).

Priya: Pushing the last changelog update now.

Sam: Tests green for SDK, merging in 10.

ReleaseBot: sdk/bump-pr -> success.

Alex: Great — once merged, I'll trigger the tag sweep and notify infra to prepare the publish window. Will post back with exact tag names. :thumbsup:
